messages.subject: Pennington v Tregarth - letter of instruction (TB-7208-HP bearing failures)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dr Renwick,

Further to our discussion, please find attached our formal letter of instruction in the Pennington bearing matter. We are couriering the 24 sampled bearings to you separately, bagged by batch, together with the ES-4471 specification and Tregarth's data sheet.

We would be grateful for a draft report by 13 December if at all possible.

Kind regards,
Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com

Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Pennington v Tregarth - letter of instruction (TB-7208-HP bearing failures)
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Received, thank you. The instruction is clear. On a first look at the photographs you sent, the spalling pattern is sub-surface, which already points away from misapplication, but I'll reserve judgment until I have hardness traverses on the rings.

Draft by 13 December should be achievable.

Adrian

Dr Adrian Renwick CEng FIMMM
Argent Metallurgical Services
